title: Ten degree-100 cyclic fields with exact profile budgets and pair-table cubes

claims.statement: The explicit ten-field degree-100 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-100 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 6042973234301425412883128099457/50000000000000000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=5846006549323608681109265339557759069410112198083 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^162.

experiments.purpose: Check field, Hamming rows, 227-operation cube and exact work (0), ten pair cutoffs and proper-run lengths 1–5 (1), 231 exact child weights (2), and proper-run lengths 6–9 and exact error (3).
